UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\" && echo 'Downloading {{ServerTarballURL}}' && wget -nv -O star-conflict-server.tar.gz '{{ServerTarballURL}}' || { echo 'Server tarball download failed. Aborting'; rm -f star-conflict-server.tar.gz; exit 1; }"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Write-Output 'Downloading {{ServerTarballURL}}'; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri '{{ServerTarballURL}}' -OutFile '{{$FullRootDir}}star-conflict-server.tar.gz' } catch { Write-Output 'Server tarball download failed. Aborting'; exit 1 }"

-NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '{{$FullBaseDir}}' | Out-Null; & tar.exe -xzf '{{$FullRootDir}}star-conflict-server.tar.gz' -C '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Remove-Item -Force '{{$FullRootDir}}star-conflict-server.tar.gz'"

-c "S=\"{{$FullRootDir}}212070\"; [ -d \"$S/cloud\" ] || { echo \"Steam files not found in $S. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; mkdir -p \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\" && cp -al --remove-destination \"$S/.\" \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\" && echo \"Server files hard-linked from $S\""

-NoProfile -Command "$s = '{{$FullRootDir}}212070'; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $s 'cloud'))) { Write-Output ('Steam files not found in ' + $s + '. Aborting'); exit 1 }; & robocopy.exe $s '{{$FullBaseDir}}' /E /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ge 8) { Write-Output 'Copying the Steam files failed'; exit 1 }; Write-Output ('Server files copied from ' + $s); exit 0"
